answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. To claim a slot, an agent burns twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs as a non-refundable ferrous stake. A tide of 100 fakes burns 100,000 credits at 1,000 each before earning a cent, more than they could ever split. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards. A comet audit sweeps slots each epoch: copied work forfeits the deposit, and renting reputation slashes the guarantor too.
